omissions.claim_en: Integrating the identifier into cadastral and municipal systems can require interface, software, testing/migration and organisational work; the response presents these as possible unquantified inputs.
omissions.reason: Separate the conditional work-input mechanism from excluded numerical forecasts or financing preferences. Existing model/compatibility and preprocessing requirements, and the proposal’s own software-conversion model, support possible implementation work. No realised municipal amount, mandatory cost in every system, or adequacy conclusion is established.

omissions.claim_en: Wrong, missing or outdated owner data delay and increase project costs or generate more administrative work in workflows relying on these data.
omissions.reason: The present-tense causal premise is separate from hoped-for future policy gains. AdV error/preprocessing scenarios support a conditional rework mechanism; no evidence establishes the full breadth or frequency of project delays/cost effects. Retain unresolved for the full proposition, rather than promoting a partial mechanism into universal proof.

limitations: All seven originals and 26 physical pages were independently read before the frozen B dispositions. All 63 outcomes and page-based exclusions were audited. No new error candidate is proposed.
DATABUND is undated; printed author dates are not verified delivery dates. The archived proposal is identified by exact hash without authenticating every original dispatch.
Only relevant passages of long background laws/specifications were read; extents are explicit. No fresh long target expansion was undertaken.
Historical uptime, actual ID possession and nationwide coverage claims remain unresolved where matching evidence was unavailable. Missing evidence is not a factual error.
The existing short-b-040 deadline issue is confirmed and remains deduplicated; no new admission is proposed.
The later provider circular supports bounded retrospective corroboration; a complete August Gazette/operational-log reconstruction is not claimed.
Public downloads are temporary; retained authored notes bind original URLs, byte hashes where inspected, exact locators, scope and access failures.
